# atlassian_confluence_space (Data Source)

Retrieves one Confluence Cloud space by ID or by key. Exactly one of `id` or `key` must be set.

## Required OAuth scopes

When the provider authenticates as a service account, its credential must carry:

- `read:space:confluence`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_confluence_space" "example" {
  key = "DEMO"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric-string ID of the space. Exactly one of id or key is required; the other is computed from the lookup.
- `key` (String) Key of the space. Exactly one of id or key is required; the other is computed from the lookup.

### Read-Only

- `author_id` (String) Account ID of the user who created the space.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time the space was created, RFC 3339.
- `current_active_alias` (String) Currently active alias for the space. Returned by the API even though the published v2 schema omits it.
- `description` (Attributes) Space description in the plain representation. Null when the space has no description. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--description))
- `homepage_id` (String) ID of the space's homepage.
- `name` (String) Name of the space.
- `space_owner_id` (String) Account ID of the user who owns the space. Absent on some responses.
- `status` (String) Status of the space.
- `type` (String) Type of the space.

<a id="nestedatt--description"></a>
### Nested Schema for `description`

Read-Only:

- `representation` (String) Representation of value. Only plain is currently returned.
- `value` (String) Description text.
